title: Preparation of 3D Fibrin Scaffolds for Stem Cell Culture Applications
protocol: Take lyophilized fibrinogen out of the refrigerator and let it sit for 20 minutes.
Add 3 mL of Tris buffered saline (TBS) to each 35 mm petri dish.
Sprinkle approximately 100-130 mg fibrinogen onto the surface of the TBS in each dish.
Wait 5 minutes for the fibrinogen to begin to dissolve into the solution.
Cover petri dishes with lids and incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Wet dialysis tubing (7000 MW cut off) with TBS.
Pipette the fibrinogen solutions from dishes into dialysis tubing.
Fold over the top end and clamp shut with a dialysis clamp.
Place the dialysis tubing containing fibrinogen solution into a 4-liter container of TBS.
Mix the solution using a stir plate set to low speed (100 rpm).
Dialyze the solution overnight on the stir plate for at least 12 hours without changing the TBS solution.
Remove the fibrinogen solution from dialysis tubing and place it into an appropriate sized conical tube.
Filter the fibrinogen solution with a 5.0 μm syringe filter to remove large impurities in the solution.
Sterile filter the fibrinogen solution with a 0.22 μm filter into a 50 mL conical tube.
Determine the volume of the filtered fibrinogen solution using an appropriate size pipette.
Measure absorbance of the fibrinogen solution at 280 nm using the spectrophotometer.
A dilution factor of 50 is often necessary to obtain an absorbance under 1.
Calculate the concentration of protein in the fibrinogen solution using the given equation.
Determine the amount of TBS needed to dilute the fibrinogen solution to 11.1 mg/mL.
Obtain sterile thrombin and calcium chloride solutions.
Add 15 μL of thrombin solution (40 U/mL) to the right side of each well in the first row of a 24-well plate.
Add 15 μL of 50 mM calcium chloride solution to the left side of each well.
Add 270 μL of fibrinogen solution to the plate.
Shake the plate from side to side, then back and forth, to ensure thorough mixing of solutions.
Incubate the plate for 5 minutes at room temperature to allow polymerization.
Place the plates inside a 37°C incubator after the final 5-minute incubation period for complete scaffold polymerization.
Incubate the scaffold for one hour.
Select an individual embryoid body using a 20 μL pipette.
Place the selected embryoid body in the center of the fibrin scaffold.
Check with a microscope that each well contains a single embryoid body.
Add 5 μL of thrombin solution (40 U/mL) on top of each embryoid body.
Add 5 μL of 50 mM calcium chloride solution on top of each embryoid body.
Add 90 μL of fibrinogen solution to each well to encapsulate the embryoid bodies in a bubble.
Place the plate back into a 37°C incubator for an additional hour.
After incubation, add 1 mL of appropriate cell culture media to each well.
Place the plate back into the 37°C incubator.
